label: Neonatal encephalopathy
basis: Boys at higher risk of birth asphyxia injury

label: Rheumatic heart disease
basis: RHD about 1.5-2x more common in women and girls

label: Neonatal sepsis
basis: Boys at higher risk in the newborn period

label: Lymphatic filariasis
basis: Hydrocele is male-only; lymphoedema more female; infection more male

label: Typhoid & paratyphoid
basis: Roughly equal; slight male excess in some series

label: Pertussis
basis: Slight female excess in most surveillance

label: Trachoma
basis: Trichiasis and blindness about 2x more common in women

label: Neural tube defects
basis: Anencephaly and spina bifida slightly more common in girls

label: Genital herpes
basis: HSV-2 prevalence clearly higher in women

label: Food-borne trematodiases
basis: Men eat more raw fish and freshwater plants in endemic areas

label: Hearing loss
basis: Age-related and noise-induced loss slightly more male

label: Rabies
basis: More male deaths in most series

label: Schistosomiasis
basis: Varies by exposure; slight male excess

label: Acne
basis: Adult acne more common in women

label: Peripheral arterial disease
basis: Global prevalence slightly higher in women

label: Hepatitis B
basis: Chronic infection more common in men

label: Varicella & herpes zoster
basis: Zoster more common in women; varicella equal

label: Asthma
basis: Male in childhood; female in adulthood

label: Atrial fibrillation
basis: More common in men at the same age

label: HIV/AIDS
basis: Women are just over half of people with HIV
